horoscopes.horoscope: You have ideas aplenty! And you want to roll them out to anyone who will hear them. You are also in a mood to love and give. Are you thinking of taking your grandmother to the beauty parlour for a makeover? Ganesha approves. You will be smiling by the time you leave office to meet your loved one. The time you spend with him or her will reflect your happy mood. You will get interactive with your lover and enjoy the entire evening discussing some interesting topics. On this very hectic day, you will feel very energetic and remain highly enthusiastic till afternoon. But, later on your energy level may drop. Complete your urgent tasks, and go back home. Eat well and relax to regain fitness. By and large, the day doesn’t indicate financial matters on the forefront of your mind. It’s neither bad day nor a very good day for money matters. Ganesha advises you to avoid getting into investment plans today. You may not have a great start today. Confusion and indecisiveness might engross your thought process but your energy levels will improve once the day progresses. You will be able to concentrate on the work effectively. At the end of the evening, you will complete all the pending tasks, feels Ganesha.

Today is the day of showing care and concern to all family members, says Ganesha. There is a possibility that you may feel estranged from your spouse and your relationship might be in danger of hitting the dead end. Stay calm and avoid escalating the tension, for the sake of your family, if nothing else, advises Ganesha. If it’s a moonlit night, then the best thing you and your lover can do is uncork a bottle of wine and spend time on a beach in each other’s arms. This satisfying feeling will add to your joy. The rest of the night is yours- full of fun. You waste your energy after fruitless and mindless discussions. Today you should spend time to prepare a workout routine. Also make sure you start exercising immediately. Join a gym or practice yoga – do any suitable exercise – indoors or outdoors. Ganesha feels that you are likely to avoid thinking very deeply about money matters in the second half of the day. By and large, your commercial instincts are partly operative today but not fully active. Work may suffer today due to a sudden mental block. However, Ganesha will iron out these problems in the second part of the day and your confidence level should climb up a few notches. You will be able to speed up the works, feels Ganesha.

Today is an auspicious and fruitful day for you. You will become excited by every very small accomplishments. You will need to fulfill the demands made upon you by your family and friends. You will probably find yourself balancing the cheque book at home, or buying appliances for the house, says Ganesha. Luck kisses you in the love front too. Go ahead and take chances, advises Ganesha with a wink. If you are still single and plan to propose someone special, today is the day. You might win the heart of your lover. You will have a miraculous time. You will be thinking a lot today. Your logical and analytical ability will be very good today. So, you may end up taking good decisions. During the first half of the day, you will be using your mind and logic to your benefit. Focus single-mindedly on your financial situation if you want to increase your income today, advises Ganesha. If you think of too many things your mind will only get muddled. Luck is on your favour. Therefore, things should go well today. Correspondence on important tasks is in the offing. You are sincere and quick in your work. Since you will meet most of your deadlines, the time you spend in the office today will be most satisfying.

A lot can happen over a cup of coffee, and today a lot will. Things will be moving quite swiftly today; a little too swiftly to your liking. You will get a lot of authority at the workplace, and you will use it to the point of abuse. Your prime focus, however, will be your family. Even if your mind is busy thinking about how to get under the skin of certain people, your heart will be at home. Your emotional depth will intensify while expressing your feeling. Although you naturally have an emotional control, tonight you are in a mood to rush to your sweetheart and liplock. Nobody wants to bother you this stimulating night, foresees Ganesha. Ganesha’s foresight says that you will be able to address more important tasks with better energy and focus in the second half of the day however in the first half of the day either health or mood may not be so good. Today you shall be excited about spending money on things that you desire. You will be carried away by your impulses to buy something. You will be indecisive before lunch, and over-confident afterwards. The second half of the day will see you in full action, thanks to the strength empowered by planetary positions. However, it would be difficult to take up any work in the first part of the day. Therefore, watch your step very carefully, says Ganesha.

You will receive extremely good news from your friends today. You will have co-operation and the support of your spouse. You will feel emotional today. Your understanding nature will make everything easy however. You are likely to be in a state of sensitivity with regards to feelings today, says Ganesha. Lucky Colour Light Bright Yellow Getting an approval from your sweetheart for something may not be that easy today. Ganesha feels, “Time can do what patience and strength cannot.” You need to make him or her special so that you can get a green signal. Arranging a luxurious home décor will bring a smile on your face, feels Ganesha. In the first half of the day, there are chances of coming across challenges today but you will be dealing with them with due attention and confidence. However, you must not take up physically or mentally challenging tasks in the second half of the day. You are likely to have some fiscal gains during the first half of the day but later, you may have some big plans to spend money, or some unexpected expenses will come up. Take a pill, but don’t get uneasy if perfectly normal things start going haywire. In setting things right, you may skip lunch. You will get completely dedicated to finishing the pending tasks, feels Ganesha. Avoid taking a decision on crucial matters.

Look before you leap. Ganesha warns that there may be trouble brewing for you and it may catch you unawares. You will be very upbeat at work, and you realise that your high spirits benefit your colleagues too. You may reserve the evening for a quite time with your family, reminiscing the happy times spent together in the past. Nothing else will matter except your loved one’s happiness. With your stars shining brightly, the evening will send a shower of emotions rushing through your veins. Enjoy the climactic outburst! Try to make this evening a memorable one. Watching a horror-thriller movie will bring your sweetheart closer to you. It’s going to be an enjoyable day. The first half of the day will be good from health point of view. Your mind will be working at greater speed. You will not feel tired of physical or mental workload. You will surmount these loads. Finances may be expended on friends, family, further development of business, branding, publicity, pleasure and leisure. You will remain judicious and shall not exceed your budget. Things will be all lively and merry around you today. You need to stay careful when you are one step ahead on your road to professional success. However, Ganesha wants you to be everyone’s favourite. Stop saying negative things, warns Ganesha.

Some things are always remembered with fondness. Today may be one of those days when you tend to get wistful and nostalgic. Let this emotion spur you on and later in the day, you may strive hard to reconnect with your near and dear ones. Listen to your heart. You can do nothing wrong today, as your charisma will be overwhelming. Ganesha foresees a sanctified day for you. You will be able to realise your need to be with your loved one. You might play hide and seek with your sweetheart to catch his or her attention. As the evening gets darker, your partner will take the lead in fascinating you. On this highly propitious day, you shall be full of beans. Moreover, your positive attitude will motivate juniors in your office as well as home to work swiftly and zealously. You shall also be active on the social front today. Finances will be important today, but not the the most important thing. You will consider yourself to be lucky enough for money matters and will not remain upset with your financial progress or standing. You will quickly achieve routine works. Office time will be busy and you’ll have to go through many word files before you take a coffee break. Focus on improving your interpersonal skills. Your patient mind and careful words will play an important role in building a good relationship.

Get your family together today and spend most of the time with them, says Ganesha. If being practical is important, then have your close friends over at your place too. A romantic dinner with your beloved is on the cards today. Don’t be surprised with an array of delights coming your way as Ganesha has conspired that you have a wonderful rendezvous with your sweetheart tonight. Get ready to be committed and feel special in the eyes of your lover, says Ganesha. Your first half of the day may make you feel tired easily if you overload your mind. However, in the second half you may feel boosted somewhat in your energy level. Challenging tasks can be kept for the second half of the day. There may be something amiss in joint finances or in joint assets. You will be inspired to look deeply into the accounting part or you may wish to investigate where things are going wrong. The genius in you will come to the fore at the work front. You will earn your boss’ thumbs up for a job well executed. However, your real challenge will be to deliver quality work within a deadline. Boost your positive spirit with dedication and honesty.

All said and done, today Ganesha foresees you striking a fine balance between your profession and passion. Profession will win the hand during the course of the day. Your flitting in social circles is slated to take a back-seat as you tend to focus more on your work. If you go wrong anywhere today, your loved one might come to extend helping hands. Be ready to listen to your sweetheart. Chatting, eating and sleeping with your loved one will keep the relationship strong. Both of you will enjoy romance-filled blissful moments, says Ganesha. In the first half of the day, you may not face big health problems, but you could face lot many psychological challenges. You should learn to accept situation and people as they are. This will help you stay in good mood. You will be cool about money matters because you will be following your own philosophy. Even if you happen to be repaying debts along with interest, you will not be too concerned. Strong winds of opposition may try to swerve you off your course today. However, don’t let them affect you, advises Ganesha. The tact you have can help you remain anchored to handle this situation judiciously. You need to get your Plan B or Option C ready to tackle any adverse situation.

Today, you’ll open a mix bag of surprises, opportunities, challenges, and not-so good fall of events. You’ll have a tendency of letting the noticeable details fall between the cracks at work. This is certainly not a good trait to have, however, it will not harm you much. As the day progresses, you’ll encounter a delightful surprise, feels Ganesha. Your partner may not understand your feelings or may demand a long-term commitment from your side. You may not be able to decide immediately on some crucial matters. You mighr rely on time. Don’t let overwhelming emotions defeat you, advises Ganesha. The day can be demanding at both personal and professional fronts so there may be certain amount of emotional stress that you will be experiencing. You are suggested to make it a point that health does not suffer at any cost. Ganesha advises you to change your lifestyle if you really want to curb unnecessary expenses. Chances to earn easy money will be next to nil, and you will be largely without luck on this front. Having jump-started your day with lot of hard work, your batteries may go down later in the day. Your emotions and reasons will clash with each other. Amid this discord, you will wind up your day’s work sooner than usual.

It’s time for some family bonding! You realise that you’ve neglected your near and dear. Now, you need to do something substantial to win back your family’s approval. However, your sincerity alone will melt their hearts. Holding your sweetheart’s hand at dinner is a perfect way to end the day, says Ganesha. Ganesha foresees that you may not rush home for your loved one. All you want tonight is food and solitude, reveals your fortune master. A well-presented delectable international cuisine with a latest Hollywood blockbustre will please your mood for sure. There will be consistent demand from the environment, which at the end of the day will make you feel very tired. If you plan your work and rest hours, there would not be any problem. Do not stretch your working hours beyond capacity. If you have invested in the stock market, today is a good time to off-load them as you are unlikely to make so much profit in the future as you will today. Think hard about speculative dealings in the future. There’s enough technical work on your plate to keep you occupied in the first part of the day. This may leave you starved of energy and you may yearn to reach home soon. As a result, you may delay some important decisions, feels Ganesha.

Contemplating on the source which triggered problems for you recently will be the order of the day. Identifying the source is half the work done; eliminating it is just a matter of initiative and courage, says Ganesha. Ganesha suggests that you need to be extremely careful with your words since they can affect your friends more than you realise. Your loved one might not agree to the things you want to bring for him or her, foresees Ganesha. The first half of the day is good from health point of view however you may get stressed. You should follow your instincts rather than following your logic. Avoid arguing . Staying calm with others will save your energy which you burn in arguments. Ganesha advises you to keep your friends in good humour today because they can really help you to clinch some lucrative freelance projects, and make steady financial headway. With clouds of confusion constantly blocking your thoughts, things will remain hazy today. Every small thing will disturb you, making it tough for you to concentrate on a single task. Ganesha advises you to practise yoga every day to focus on the easily achievable yet important things.
